title: a colon anywhere in a path is E100 on Windows (`notes:2026.txt` would be an NTFS alternate data stream)
notes: §12 item 29. On NTFS `notes:2026.txt` names the alternate data stream `2026.txt` of a file `notes`, and `c:x.txt` is relative to the current directory of drive C:, outside the workspace; both are silent relocations, so the path is rejected as E100 on Windows. The POSIX reading is `paths-colon-is-ordinary`. The second block (`c:x.txt`) shows that the parse phase reports both blocks.
